notes.title: The new round of tests has now ended.
notes.content:
Dear fellow daoists, the new round of tests (the first public beta) for "Ancient River Map" on WeGame and Steam has now ended. We've received a lot of valuable suggestions and feedback during this test. We are extremely grateful to all fellow daoists for your support!
These suggestions and feedback will help us make the game even better. We look forward to that in the future, "Ancient River Map" will bring all fellow daoists a more excellent card game experience full of the charm of cultivating immortality. See you next time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055391/f6ffbcf92e7e6f5b13d43b33a672bbcb2be07510.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Optimizations for the Demo Version on December 27, 2024
notes.content:
1.Fix the issue of drawing duplicate cards from the card pack.
2.Fix the problem that the card "The Foolish Old Man" cannot have its discovered cards selected.
3.Fix the problem that when the card "Rebirth in Wrath" draws an attached card, its copy cannot be summoned.
4.Fix the problem that the number of spirit stones is not refreshed after purchasing a card pack.
5.Fix the problem that the keyword "Guard" blocks the selection of our targets.
6.Fix the situation where certain elixirs cannot be used under special circumstances.
7.Fix the problem that the second recommended deck of the fox spirit Ah Bai cannot be used.
8.Fix the problem that the cards "The Mantis That Eats Cicadas" and "Non-Aggression" cannot be crafted.
9.Fix the problem of incorrect effects of the cards "The Spirit Abyss Hunter" and "The Spirit Abyss Mystic".
10.Fix the problem that the card "The Sect Master of the Black Fiend Sect" can be triggered even during the opponent's turn.
11.Fix the problem that the minions with the keyword "Attach" in the hand, when attached to the minions on the field, do not inherit the buffs.
12.Fix the problem of card decomposition failure.
13.Fix the problem of incorrect card decomposition caused by one-click decomposition.
14.Fix the problem that the cards transformed by the card "The Spirit Fox" cannot be used.
15.Fix the problem of incorrect effect of the card "The Seven Stars' Finale" in the beginner's tutorial.
16.Fix the problem that the card "The Dragon's Roar in the Azure Sky" causes the game to freeze.
17.Optimize the difficulty of the first level of the hero trial for the fox spirit Ah Bai.
18.Fix the error prompt when clicking "Duel" in friendly battles.
19.Optimize the logic of card recommendations.
20.Optimize the usage conditions of the Double Fish Pendant in the beginner's tutorial.
21.Optimize the prompts for insufficient conditions for deck deployment.
22.Fix the problem that the heroes deployed in the ladder do not match their deployed decks.
23.Fix the text errors in the beginner's tutorial.
24.Fix the problem of incorrect display of the number of emails.

notes.content:
Hello, fellow daoists! The new round of testing for "Ancient star chart" has now been officially launched. You can go to the corresponding pages on Steam to download and experience it. notes.title: The new round of testing for "Ancient star chart" is about to commence.
notes.content:
Hello, fellow daoists! At 10 o'clock tomorrow morning, December 26th, "Ancient star chart" is about to start a new round of testing, which is also the first public trial play!
This test is expected to last for two weeks. Ah Bai has sorted out a series of new contents and optimizations in the new version for you all, hoping it will be helpful. Fellow daoists can experience them carefully in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055391/4da38a895295b24d46256d0b4546c523b8c8b600.jpg[/img]
New Contents:
Recommended combinations for hero cards.
Added the "Tribulation Crossing" mechanism for the Human race and the "Possession" mechanism for the Demon race.
More than 20 new cards.
Added a scarecrow practice field to "Hero Trial".
Numerical Optimizations:
Numerical optimization for card balance.
Optimization of pass rewards and task conditions.
Optimization of the levels and reward contents in "Hero Trial".
Optimization of the difficulty in "Boom Boom Mode".
Functional Optimizations:
Optimized the "Comprehension" interface.
Optimization of the novice tutorial.
Optimization of the friend interface.
Optimization of the performance of gold cards.
Optimization of the scene interaction during battles.

notes.title: The demo of "Ancient Star Chart" is now available for download.
notes.content:
Hello, players! The trial version of "Ancient Star Chart" is now available for download.
Test time: From 10:00 on October 14th to 10:00 on October 28th (CST).
Game Introduction: In the realm of ink-wash, the way of friendly duels. "Ancient Star Chart" is a CCG card game developed by Hetu Studio with the theme of cultivating immortality in Eastern mythology. Currently, there are two modes, PVP and PVE. In the PVE mode, players will play as ancient heroes, raise followers, and explore the secret treasures of the Dragon Palace. In the PVP mode, players need to build card decks based on the characteristics of heroes from the three major races of humans, demons, and gods to duel with other players.
The game is still in development. The test content does not represent the final effect.
For more activities during the test period, please join our community to check. Welcome all players to come and experience!
